content: The deep cervical lymph nodes are a collection of lymph nodes located adjacent to the internal jugular vein. These nodes are categorized into two primary groups: the upper (or superior) group and the lower (or inferior) group. Alternatively, they can be classified into deep anterior cervical lymph nodes and deep lateral cervical lymph nodes. Another method of classification divides them into three distinct groups: the superior deep jugular nodes, the middle deep jugular nodes, and the inferior deep jugular nodes.
